title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-17
source: SBD > RTR @ 15 I.p.s. > PCM > D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a rare July 1966 garage‑band era show, highlighted by an early rendition of “In The Pines”.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as superb and likely recorded from the board by Owsley (“Bear”), delivering crystal‑clear audio that lets listeners hear the raw, garage‑rock vibe of the Dead in July 1966. While a few reviewers note it doesn’t have the explosive energy of later ’66 dates, the rarity of the material – especially the early version of “In The Pines” – makes it a must‑hear for any Deadhead.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (3–5) with multiple comments praising the recording’s clarity and the show’s unique early‑era material; only minor criticism about set duplication, yielding an overall strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call it “superb” and “relatively excellent audio quality”, attributing the tape to Owsley (“Bear”). No drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑1966 garage‑band style set with raw, lo‑fi energy; not as high‑octane as later ’66 dates but notable for rare early material.
